recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7356 unless the work group wants a broader editorial rewrite of Resource Identity, which would be outside this issue's narrow applied correction.
issue_request: FHIR-7356 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 Resource Identity text. It asked to avoid ambiguous "may not" wording and clarify the distinction between full/location identity and local/logical id when a resource is copied to another server.
initial_application: The Jira comment says svn revision 6430 applied the change. Git commit 3d7d55ef1615c3ef845da02f3397566936f2d7e4 maps to that revision and changed source/resource/resource-notes.xml from "may not retain the same identity" to wording about a copied resource not being able to retain the same logical identity.
additional_context: The current built Resource narrative is in active Resource infrastructure build scope. Later Resource Identity work, including FHIR-9089 and commit 7ee661f6b4022414f36a63274872d7ef207a8716, refactored the section to distinguish location/full URL identity from logical id and resolvability more explicitly. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/resource/resource-notes.xml already says a server-assigned id is never changed and that a copy might or might not keep the same logical id on the new server, avoiding the ambiguous seed phrase while preserving the intended meaning.
